components.label: SpiderSwing traversal prototype and source notices

notes.firstLaunch: Development test draft only. Melty starts the user-installed Marvel's Spider-Man Remastered companion first with -scripts, then GTA V Legacy build 1.0.3889.0 in Story Mode. The current slice adds basic web tether traversal to GTA's current player model. This launch pairing is not yet a verified content bridge: Remastered Peter Parker models, suits, animations, sounds, and Overstrike mods do not yet drive the GTA character. Never use this mod in GTA Online.
